questions.question: Ashish Sankrityayan is an exponent of _________ music.
questions.solution: Ashish Sankrityayan is a distinguished exponent of Dhrupad, the oldest surviving genre of Hindustani classical music. He belongs to the Dagarvani tradition, which emphasizes the meditative and pure tonal aspects of the raga through the use of Alaap.

questions.question: Who among the following is associated with the Tabla?
questions.solution:
Ustad Zakir Hussain is the most iconic contemporary master of the Tabla.

Quick Check: Sultan Khan was a Sarangi player, Amjad Ali Khan plays Sarod, and Hariprasad Chaurasia plays the Bansuri.

questions.question: S Balachander a famous musician from India is known for playing which of the following instruments?
questions.solution: S. Balachander was a legendary virtuoso of the Veena (specifically the Saraswati Veena). He was also a celebrated filmmaker and is credited with innovating a style of playing that allowed for the intricate nuances of vocal music to be reproduced on the instrument.

questions.question: Sheikh Chinna Moula was an exponent of the ________, a musical instrument.
questions.solution: Sheik Chinna Moulana was an legendary exponent of the Nadhaswaram, a traditional double-reed wind instrument from South India. He was a pioneer in bringing this instrument, traditionally played in temples and weddings, to the classical concert stage.

questions.question: The Kathak dance exponent Birju Maharaj is associated with which of the following Gharana?
questions.solution: The late Pandit Birju Maharaj was the leading light of the Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin Gharana of Kathak. He was a descendant of the legendary Maharaj family and was renowned for his rhythmic mastery and delicate Abhinaya.

questions.question: Bickram Ghosh, a recipient of Global Indian Music Award, is a music composer and an Indian classical _________ player.
questions.solution: Bickram Ghosh is a celebrated Tabla player and music composer. He is known for his work in the 'Rhythmscape' fusion genre and has collaborated with global artists, earning him the Global Indian Music Award (GIMA).

questions.question: Umayalpuram K Sivaraman, a Padma Vibhushan awardee, is a ________ player.
questions.solution: Umayalpuram K. Sivaraman is a titan of the Mridangam, the primary percussion instrument in Carnatic music. A Padma Vibhushan recipient, he is celebrated for his technical brilliance and his efforts in the scientific research of the instrument's acoustics.

questions.question: __________ is a world-renowned exponent of the Bansuri or bamboo flute.
questions.solution: Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia is a world-renowned maestro of the Bansuri (bamboo flute). He is credited with expanding the possibilities of the flute, making it a powerful solo instrument in Hindustani classical music.

questions.question: Pandit Ananda Gopal Bandopadhyay was a _________ player of the Banaras gharana.
questions.solution: Pandit Ananda Gopal Bandopadhyay was a distinguished Tabla player of the Banaras Gharana. He was known for his mastery over the Purab Ang (Eastern style) and for accompanying many of the greatest vocalists of his time.

questions.question: Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan is also known as ______.
questions.solution: Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan, a legend of the Patiala Gharana, is often hailed as the Tansen of the 20th Century. His voice spanned three octaves and his command over Khayal and Thumri remains unparalleled.

questions.question: Ustad Bismillah Khan is best known for playing which of the following instruments?
questions.solution: Ustad Bismillah Khan is the man who single-handedly popularized the Shehnai as a classical instrument. He was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2001 and famously performed at the Red Fort on the eve of India's Independence.

questions.question: Ustad Alla Rakha is famous for his contribution to playing which of the following instruments in Indian Music?
questions.solution: Ustad Alla Rakha was a legendary Tabla player of the Punjab Gharana. He frequently accompanied Pt. Ravi Shankar and played a crucial role in introducing Indian percussion to Western audiences.

questions.question: Famous musician Shakoor Khan was associated with which of the following musical instruments?
questions.solution: Ustad Shakoor Khan was one of the most eminent Sarangi players of the 20th century. Belonging to the Kirana Gharana, he was instrumental in ensuring the Sarangi maintained its status as a premier solo and accompanying instrument.

questions.question: Which of the following Hindustani musical Gharanas is the oldest among all the Khayal Gayaki styles?
questions.solution: The Gwalior Gharana is considered the oldest of all the Khayal gharanas. Most other gharanas like Agra, Jaipur, and Kirana find their roots in or were influenced by the style and structure of Gwalior.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
questions.option_4: Miyan Tansen – One of the nine jewels
questions.solution:
Ustad Bismillah Khan – Sitar is the incorrectly matched pair. Bismillah Khan was a maestro of the Shehnai.

Correct pairs: Ali Akbar Khan (Sarod), Hariprasad Chaurasia (Bansuri), and Tansen (one of Akbar's Navratnas).

questions.question: Totaram Sharma is an exponent of ____________.
questions.solution: Pandit Totaram Sharma is a renowned exponent of the Pakhawaj. He is one of the leading masters of this ancient barrel-drum, which is the primary accompaniment for Dhrupad singing.

questions.question: Sheik Chinna Moulana used to play which of the following instruments?
questions.solution: Sheik Chinna Moulana (also spelled Moulana) was a master of the Nadhaswaram. He was the first from his community to be awarded the Sangeetha Kalanidhi by the Madras Music Academy.

questions.question: Which of the following instruments is played by Anokhelal Mishra?
questions.solution: Pandit Anokhelal Mishra, famously known as the 'Samrat of Laya', was a legendary Tabla player of the Banaras Gharana. He was particularly famous for his incredible speed and clarity in playing Na-Dhin-Dhin-Na.

questions.question: Thetakudi Harihara Vinayakram, an Indian percussionist, is known for popularising which of the following musical instruments?
questions.solution: T.H. Vinayakram, affectionately known as Vikku Vinayakram, is a Grammy-winning percussionist who globalized the Ghatam (clay pot). He was a key member of the fusion band Shakti alongside John McLaughlin and Zakir Hussain.

questions.question: Who among the following Indian Musicians and tabla players was the very first to be invited in 2016 by the then American President Barack Obama to attend the All-Star Global Concert held in the White House?
questions.solution: Ustad Zakir Hussain was the first Indian musician invited by President Barack Obama to perform at the All-Star Global Concert at the White House in 2016 to celebrate International Jazz Day.

questions.question: Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan was renowned a____________.
questions.solution: Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan was a legendary Classical Singer. His contribution to the Patiala Gharana and his ability to blend technical complexity with deep emotional resonance made him a towering figure in music history.

questions.question: Vilayat Khan is associated with which musical instrument?
questions.solution: Ustad Vilayat Khan was a maestro of the Sitar and a rival to Pt. Ravi Shankar. He developed the Gayaki Ang on the sitar, allowing the instrument to mimic the subtle glides and nuances of the human voice.

questions.question: Which of the following Carnatic instruments is performed by Rajna Swaminathan?
questions.solution: Rajna Swaminathan is an acclaimed Mridangam player and composer. She is one of the few women to excel in this traditionally male-dominated percussion instrument and is known for her cross-genre collaborations in New York's jazz scene.

questions.question: Which of the following instruments is played by P Mani Iyer?
questions.solution: Palghat Mani Iyer was a legendary Mridangam player who redefined the role of percussion in Carnatic music. He was the first mridangist to receive the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and the Padma Bhushan.

questions.question: Ustad Amjad Ali Khan, a renowned musician from India is known for playing which of the following instruments?
questions.solution: Ustad Amjad Ali Khan is a world-famous Sarod player representing the sixth generation of the Bangash lineage. He is credited with making the Sarod more lyrical and expressive through his unique playing style.
